description: This file defines the LuceneContentIndexProfileHandler class, which manages indexing profiles for Lucene within OrchardCore, including setting mappings and populating index metadata.

classes.name: LuceneContentIndexProfileHandler
classes.description: Handles Lucene index profile setup and updates, including mapping configuration and index metadata population.

methods.name: LuceneContentIndexProfileHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for content management, index handlers, and logging.

methods.name: CreatingAsync
methods.description: Handles creation of index profile mappings.

methods.name: UpdatingAsync
methods.description: Handles updating of index profile mappings.

methods.name: SetMappingsAsync
methods.description: Configures index mappings based on profile metadata.

methods.name: PopulateAsync
methods.description: Populates index metadata and settings from JSON data.

methods.name: CanHandle
methods.description: Checks if the index profile is suitable for this handler based on provider and type.

methods.name: PopulateTypeMappingAsync
methods.description: Builds a set of index fields based on content types and their entries.
